title: privacy-export-lifecycle-report acceptance evidence

preconditions.const: Operations: identity.privacy-export.request, identity.privacy-export.status, identity.privacy-export.cancel, identity.privacy-export.download; exact inputs: tenant_id, subject_id, export_id, idempotency_key, contributor_checkpoints, worker_interrupt_after_fragment, projection_or_staged_fragment_mode, locale_preference, erasure_operation_id, erasure_failure_point, legal_hold_version; initial state: subject has exportable records including an identity/i18n locale preference and no equivalent active job; each exact contributor can reproduce its recorded checkpoint through a versioned projection or immutable request-transaction fragment

stimulus.const: Run identity.privacy-export.request then identity.privacy-export.status then identity.privacy-export.cancel then identity.privacy-export.download for success, failure, denial, outage, concurrency, cleanup, unknown-outcome cases using tenant_id, subject_id, export_id, idempotency_key, contributor_checkpoints, worker_interrupt_after_fragment, projection_or_staged_fragment_mode, locale_preference, erasure_operation_id, erasure_failure_point, legal_hold_version and capture every required artifact field

expected_outcome.const: Invariant: request captures the immutable exact contributor set including identity/i18n and version vector; restart reconstructs every contributor at the recorded checkpoint without a long-lived exported PostgreSQL snapshot; mixed cuts are rejected; cancel immediately denies download then reports erasure-pending, erasure-outcome-unknown, erased, or retained-encrypted-under-hold; timeout never claims erasure; status and reconciliation reuse one operation generation; hold release resumes erasure; completed download is bounded and auditable; stable outcomes: success=pass/none, failure=failed/internal, denial=denied/forbidden, outage=unavailable/unavailable, concurrency=pass/conflict, cleanup=pass/none, unknown-outcome=reconciled/unknown_commit; required artifact fields: export_id, erasure_operation_id, job_version, erasure_generation, exported_record_count, contributor_checkpoint_count, i18n_contributor_count, restart_resumed_contributor_count, worker_restart_count, long_lived_postgres_snapshot_count, mixed_cut_rejected, download_denied_after_cancel, outcome_unknown_not_erased, hold_release_resumed_erasure, snapshot_version_vector_digest, restart_reconstruction_digest, erasure_evidence_digest, temporary_artifact_count, lifecycle_event_digest, privacy_lifecycle_results
